about.title: Meet your Manurewa builder
about.introduction: On Site Building Construction was founded in 2003. Based in Manurewa, our team brings over 30 years of building experience to new homes, renovations and extensions across South Auckland and beyond. Whether we’re building from the ground up or making room for a growing family, we keep you involved with honest advice and clear communication from the start.
